name: Greater Fireball
description: A condensed sphere of arcane flame, costlier than the basic cast but hotter on impact.
flavor_text: The System logs every cast. It finds the heat... interesting.

name: Frost Lance
description: A piercing bolt of crystallised cold. Slows enemy reactions on hit.

name: Arcane Bolt
description: A raw discharge of unformed arcane energy. No element, no subtlety — just force.
flavor_text: Even the System cannot fully categorise raw arcane force.

name: Healing Light
description: Channel restorative energy to mend wounds. Restores HP proportional to WIS.
flavor_text: The System monitors healing. Too much makes it nervous.
